**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Dear [Charles](../persons.html#1043),
I think I can let you have a story called Burrs, about choir boys if you like to have it.

It will be published as part of a volume called [Langley Adventures](../books.html#163) about Christmas but you will have the start

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: Envelope addressed to ‘The Revd/ C Moor/Grimsby/ Lincolnshire’ and postmarked Winchester 1 October 1883.

Charles Moor (b. 1857/8) was the son of the Rev.

John Frewen Moor, and was perhaps running a parish magazine.
